cases.prompt: A recorded run completed locally while Central remained working at sequence 2. Inspect the historical source and observation documents. Explain the supported failure chain, propose the smallest safe repair boundary, list regression checks, and state what is still unproven. Do not assume local completion proves delivered output.

rubric.text: Join the observed sequence-3 recommendation stop with the schema enum violation and the Go decoder missing semantic validation; do not blame provider latency or the Finalizer selection.
Propose validating optional assessment before attaching it, preserving visible output on invalid metadata; do not coerce stop into approval or relax the wire schema.
Cover invalid enum and other schema-invalid metadata, valid metadata, reply/completion delivery and Central final-answer binding with proposed regressions.
Cite observation and code/schema document IDs and distinguish a supported diagnosis from unperformed repair, delivery verification and provider conclusions.

cases.prompt: The same commit passed main CI but its protected Release gate canceled the Hosted client-disconnect test after five seconds. Inspect the historical source and recorded CI observation. Recommend a bounded test repair that distinguishes setup delays from cancellation failures, identify what must remain a strict gate, and explain the limits of the diagnosis. A timeout alone is not proof of a production cancellation defect.

rubric.text: Identify the five-second whole-test envelope includes setup, dispatch, cancellation and teardown, and the same-source CI difference does not prove a production defect.
Separate bounded setup/provider-start allowance from a strict five-second cancel-to-abort gate plus bounded request settlement and shutdown; do not only enlarge the whole test.
Prevent the provider 15-second deadline from being mistaken for client/shutdown cancellation; propose a negative or isolated cancellation regression for both triggers.
Cite test and CI/runtime evidence and preserve uncertainty about runner contention; no claim that suggested code, native CI or a Release has been verified.

documents.content:
Exact-source main CI run
[33752581392](https://github.com/chenrgSix/ConveneWire/actions/runs/33752581392)
passed all four jobs for
`1f519bddca81c9931e5354cae81a7b7476f02d51`. Protected Release run
[33753323037](https://github.com/chenrgSix/ConveneWire/actions/runs/33753323037)
ran the same source, but its Repository gate reported 593 passes, zero ordinary
failures and one canceled Server test after the five-second whole-test timeout.
The affected test was `Hosted configuration probes abort HTTPS on client
disconnect`; every asset-producing job was skipped and the Draft retained zero
assets.

cases.prompt: Historical Windows users reported installed native launchers and an npm codex.cmd shim as missing or rejected before a Runtime probe. Use the pre-fix discovery, Console and CLI evidence to locate all relevant checks and recommend one consistent minimal policy. Preserve Unix behavior and discovery without execution; propose portable and native-platform verification separately. Do not change Runtime permissions.

rubric.text: Identify Unix execute-bit gating in Console/discovery and CLI enrollment plus known-directory candidates trying only .exe on Windows.
Use one regular-file platform rule: Windows case-insensitive .exe/.com/.bat/.cmd, Unix execute bits; preserve PATH lookup and bounded discovery without auto-running candidates.
Propose coverage for no-execute-bit Windows launchers, unsupported .ps1/directory rejection, Unix behavior, known candidates and enrollment/preflight callers.
Cite discovery and independent Console/CLI evidence; separate portable tests/cross-compilation from actual native Windows launch/preflight and do not claim this replay verifies those.
